entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Djamila Debèche, sometimes written Debêche or Debbeche, was a French-Algerian feminist writer. She was a pioneering journalist and novelist in Algeria, where she was one of the first women writers of the French colonial period.

entities.summary: Djamila Debèche, sometimes written Debêche or Debbeche, was a French-Algerian feminist writer. She was a pioneering journalist and novelist in Algeria, where she was one of the first women writers of the French colonial period.
